start.tagline: The deposit that never leaves your account.

renter.label: For renters
renter.title: I'm renting
renter.body: Open the rental link the shop sent you, or scan its code at the counter.
renter.saved: {count, plural, one {# rental on this phone} other {# rentals on this phone}}

shop.label: For shops
shop.title: I work at a shop
shop.body: Hand items over, photograph returns and check drop-offs.

rentals.title: Your rentals

empty.title: No rentals on this phone yet
empty.body: The shop sends a link by email or text when you book, and shows a code at the counter. Open either one here.

rentals.removed: Removed from this phone. The rental itself is unchanged.

addLink.title: Paste a link
addLink.hint: It starts with https:// and has /r/ in it.
addLink.missing: Paste the link the shop sent you.
addLink.invalid: That is not a Hold rental link. Check you copied all of it.

scan.title: Scan the shop's code
scan.hint: Point the camera at the code on the counter or on the shop's screen.
scan.notHold: That code is not a Hold rental link. Ask the shop to show yours.
scan.cameraReason: To read the shop's code at the counter. Nothing is photographed or kept.

rental.title: Your rental
rental.holdBody: Placed when you collect, in your own PayPal account. This is not a charge. If everything comes back as it left, the hold is released the moment you return it.
rental.holdRules: A person at the shop approves every charge. You see any claim before it is taken, with the photographs and the price, and you can disagree. You have {hours} hours to reply.
rental.pricesLead: A claim can only be for what is on this list.
rental.wearLead: You are never charged for this.

status.next: Next: at pickup, you approve the hold on your phone.
status.lapsed: The time to pay ran out, and the items were booked by someone else. Contact the shop to book again.
status.abandoned: This booking was let go. Contact the shop to book again.
status.awaiting_hold: The shop is ready for your hold.
status.holdNext: Approve the hold on this phone to collect your items.
status.ready: Your hold is placed. You can collect your items.
status.dropped_off: You returned it at the drop point. A person at the shop will check it.

results.link_invalid: This link cannot be used. Ask the shop for a new one.
results.rate_limited: Too many tries from this network. Wait a minute and try again.
results.not_pending: This booking is not waiting for a payment.
results.payment_lapsed: The time to pay ran out, and the items were booked by someone else.
results.paypal_not_connected: The shop cannot take payments yet. Contact the shop.
results.paypal_unavailable: PayPal could not be reached. Nothing was charged. Try again in a moment.
results.not_approved: PayPal has not confirmed your approval yet. Nothing was charged.
results.declined: PayPal declined the payment. Nothing was charged.
results.order_mismatch: This payment does not belong to this rental. Nothing was charged.
results.amount_mismatch: PayPal's amount did not match the fee. The shop has been told.
results.not_completed: PayPal has not completed the payment yet.
results.not_requested: The shop has not asked for the hold yet. They do when you collect your items.
results.hold_refused: PayPal could not place the hold. Nothing was reserved. Ask the shop.
results.closed: The time to answer has passed.
results.not_handed_over: The rental has not been handed over yet.
results.upload_failed: The photograph did not upload. Try again.
results.not_out: Reports are open while you have the items.
results.description_invalid: Describe what happened, in up to 1,000 characters.
results.region_invalid: Keep the box on the photograph, close around the damage.
results.not_agreeable: This price cannot be agreed now. The page shows where the report stands.
results.not_theft: These details are for a theft or loss waiting for the shop.
results.storage_unavailable: Photographs cannot be taken here right now.
results.key_mismatch: That photograph does not belong to this report.
results.not_uploaded: The photograph did not arrive. Take it again.
results.sealed: This report was sent, so no photograph can be added.
results.unknown_view: That view is not one of this item’s.
results.not_connected: No assistant is connected to this rental now.
results.not_allowed: This shop takes returns at the counter only.
results.not_ready: This rental cannot be returned here now.
results.staff_returning: Staff are already taking this return at the counter.
results.photo_reused: This photograph was used before. Take a new one of the item as it is now.
results.views_missing: Some photographs are still to take.
results.no_quote: Choose the new return time first.
results.quote_stale: The rental changed since this price was given. Choose the new time again.

selfReturn.closedTitle: The shop is closed. You can still return it.
selfReturn.body: Photograph it the way it was photographed when you took it, leave it at the drop point, and you are done. It counts as returned the moment you send.

assistantState.connected: An assistant is connected to this rental

rental.consentQuestion: Use my record of clean returns to lower future holds at Hold shops.

signIn.title: Sign in to your shop
signIn.lead: For owners and counter staff. Hold emails you a code that works once.
signIn.codeLead: We sent a code to {email}. It works once, within ten minutes.
signIn.resent: A new code is on its way. Use the code in the newest email.
signIn.renting: Renting something? You need no account.

problems.emailInvalid: That does not look like an email address. Check it and try again.
problems.codeMissing: Enter the code from the email.
problems.codeInvalid: The code is the digits in the email. Check it and try again.
problems.wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
problems.expired: That code has expired. Send a new one.
problems.attempt_over: This code can no longer be used. Send a new one, or start again.
problems.second_factor: This account also asks for a code from an authenticator app, which Hold does not take yet.
problems.busy: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes, then try again.
problems.unavailable: Hold could not check the code just now. Try again in a moment.

demo.title: Try the demo shop
demo.lead: Each demo is a Ribeira Bikes of your own, with rentals already under way. One tap starts it: nothing to type, no code to wait for.
demo.leadCurrent: This phone has a demo of your own. Come back to it as either person, or start a fresh one.

owner.start: Start a demo as Tomás, the owner
owner.hint: Sees everything and decides every claim.
owner.name: Tomás, the owner

staff.start: Start a demo as Jonas, at the counter
staff.continue: Continue as Jonas, at the counter
staff.hint: Hands bikes over, takes them back and approves small claims.
staff.name: Jonas, at the counter

demo.freshHint: A new shop and new accounts, as Tomás. The demo you have now stays as it is.
demo.note: PayPal runs in its sandbox, so no real money moves. A step that moves money is decided on the web, with a passkey.

chooseShop.title: Choose a shop
chooseShop.lead: You work in more than one shop. Choose the one at this counter.
chooseShop.noShopTitle: You are not part of a shop yet
chooseShop.noShopBody: Ask the shop's owner to invite you, then sign in with that email address.

account.title: You
account.demoNote: A demo shop of your own. Its rentals are samples and PayPal runs in its sandbox.

decisions.title: {count, plural, =0 {No decisions are waiting} one {# thing needs a decision} other {# things need a decision}}
decisions.body: Claims, releases and contested charges are decided on the web, where a passkey confirms the person. Nothing is charged from this phone.
decisions.none: Claims to approve and holds near their end appear on the web's decision board.

today.dropOffs: {count, plural, one {# return waits at the drop point} other {# returns wait at the drop point}}
today.emptyBody: Rentals that start or end today appear here, in the order of the day.

rentals.searchHint: A name, an email or an item
rentals.emptyBody: Rentals are booked on the web or on the shop's page. They appear here to hand over and take back.
rentals.noMatchBody: Try part of the renter's name, or the item's.

rental.title: Rental
rental.sample: A sample rental for the demo. Nothing is photographed, emailed or charged for it.
rental.readOnly: Your role can see this rental but not act on it at the counter.
rental.decidedOnWeb: Claims, releases and approvals for this rental are decided on the web.

hold.title: Hold at pickup
hold.none: No hold yet. The renter approves it in PayPal on their own phone.
hold.placed: Reserved in the renter's PayPal account
hold.requested: Waiting for the renter to approve
hold.askHint: Shows a code the renter scans to approve the hold in PayPal. Asking moves no money.

link.title: The renter's link
link.body: The renter sees the rental, pays and approves the hold here. Show it at the counter, or send it.

handover.title: Handover
handover.body: Photograph each item before it leaves. Once every item is sealed, the rental is out.

return.title: Return
return.body: Photograph each item as it comes back. A person decides what happens next, on the web.

link.renterBody: It opens the rental on the renter's phone: the terms, the fee and the hold.
link.holdBody: The renter approves the hold in PayPal on their own phone. Nothing is taken now.
link.condition: Scan to see the condition report

dropOffs.lead: Items renters returned with nobody at the counter. Look at the drop point first. The hold stays and nothing is charged until a person has seen the item.
dropOffs.emptyBody: When a renter returns an item themselves, it waits here for a person to check it.
dropOffs.confirmTitle: Record that it is not at the drop point?
dropOffs.confirmBody: Hold records who looked and when, and may email the renter. The hold stays in place and nothing is charged.
dropOffs.recorded: Recorded. The hold stays in place.
dropOffs.recordedTold: Recorded, and the renter was emailed. The hold stays in place.

capture.guidanceHandover: Photograph each view. Box any mark that is already there, so it is never charged to this renter.
capture.guidanceReturn: Match each handover view using the faint photograph over the camera. Record what came back; a person decides what happens next.
capture.marksCount: {count, plural, =0 {No marks} one {# mark} other {# marks}}
capture.toCheck: {count, plural, one {# known mark to check} other {# known marks to check}}

upload.upload_failed: The photograph did not upload. Check the connection and try again.
upload.not_uploaded: The photograph did not arrive. Take it again.
upload.key_mismatch: That photograph belongs to another view. Take it again.
upload.too_large: The photograph is too large. Take it again.
upload.unreadable: The photograph could not be read on this phone. Take it again.

seal.ready: Every needed view is photographed. Sealing fixes them and chains them to the item's history.
seal.missing: {count, plural, one {One view still needs} other {# views still need}} a photograph.
seal.waiting: Wait for the uploads to finish.
seal.next: Sealed. Photograph the rental's next item.
seal.emailed: The renter has been emailed the condition report. They can also scan this code.
seal.texted: The renter has been texted the condition report. They can also scan this code.
seal.show: Show the renter this code. It opens the condition report, which they confirm or add to within 24 hours.
seal.returned: Return sealed. The photographs are being compared. Nothing has been charged.
seal.returnedNext: Return sealed. Photograph the rental's next item.
seal.sealedHandover: Sealed. These photographs can no longer change.
seal.sealedReturn: These return photographs are sealed. Nothing has been charged.

marks.title: Marks
marks.lead: Marks already on the item when it leaves are never charged to this renter.
marks.howTo: Tap the mark on the photograph, or drag a box around it.
marks.boxAt: {x}% from the left, {y}% from the top, {width}% wide, {height}% high
marks.descriptionHint: Such as: scratch on the top tube, 2 cm
marks.noPhoto: Photograph this view first, then box its marks.
marks.readOnly: Sealed. These marks are part of the item's history.

review.title: What you saw
review.lead: Write what you observed and why. This saves your observation with your name; it does not approve a charge.
review.recorded: Your inspection has been recorded. A claim, if any, is prepared and approved on the web.

itemStatus.title: Item status
itemStatus.lead: A flat tyre sends an item to repair. It is not offered to renters until it is back in service.

message.title: Write to the renter
message.lead: An answer on the claim. The renter reads it on their link and is emailed.
message.needsText: Write a message of up to 1000 characters.

web.title: This is decided on the web
web.body: Money decisions need a passkey, on Hold's web app. Nothing was changed from this phone.

reasons.not_ready: The hold must be placed before the handover.
reasons.not_found: That is no longer in this shop.
reasons.storage_unavailable: Photographs cannot be stored here yet. Ask the shop's owner.
reasons.sealed: These photographs are sealed and cannot change.
reasons.session_sealed: These photographs are sealed and cannot change.
reasons.unknown_view: That view is not in this item's photo plan.
reasons.views_missing: Some views still need a photograph.
reasons.region_invalid: Draw the box inside the photograph.
reasons.description_invalid: Describe the mark in up to 200 characters.
reasons.no_email: This booking has no email to send to.
reasons.email_failed: The email could not be sent. Show the link instead.
reasons.not_booked: The fee must be paid before the hold is asked for.
reasons.not_dropped_off: This item is no longer waiting at the drop point.
reasons.already_reported: It is already recorded as not found.
reasons.role_may_not_retire: Only the owner or a manager can retire an item.
reasons.item_in_use: A renter has the item, or its return is still being checked. Change it once it is back and checked.
reasons.message_invalid: Write a message of up to 1000 characters.
reasons.transition_not_allowed: The rental is not at that step.

permission.title: Hold needs the camera
permission.body: To photograph the item when it is handed over and when it comes back, so both sides have the same record. Nothing else.
permission.deniedTitle: The camera is turned off for Hold
permission.deniedBody: Turn it on in Settings to take the photographs. Until then, the shop can take them at the counter.

capture.alignHint: Line the item up with the faint photograph from the handover.
capture.review: Is the whole item sharp and in frame?
capture.failed: The photograph could not be taken. Try again.

code.label: One-time code
code.hint: {length} digits, from the email or text Hold sent you.

offline.title: No connection
offline.body: This phone is offline. Nothing was changed. Try again when you have a signal.

timeout.title: Hold is taking too long to answer
timeout.body: Nothing was changed. Try again in a moment.

unexpected.title: Something went wrong
unexpected.body: Hold could not show this. Nothing was charged and nothing was changed.

link_invalid.title: This link cannot be used
link_invalid.body: It may be mistyped, or it has ended. Ask the shop for a new one.

signed_out.title: You are signed out
signed_out.body: Sign in again to carry on.

refused.title: Hold did not do that
refused.body: Nothing was charged and nothing was changed.

scope.title: This link cannot do that
scope.body: Ask the shop to help you with it.

rate_limited.title: Too many tries
rate_limited.body: Wait a minute, then try again.

invalid.title: Some details are not right
invalid.body: Check what you entered and try again.

no_shop.title: You are not part of a shop yet
no_shop.body: Ask the shop's owner to add you.

role.title: Your role cannot do this
role.body: Ask an owner or a manager.

passkey_needed.title: Confirm with your passkey
passkey_needed.body: This needs the passkey on this phone.

not_found.title: Not found
not_found.body: It may have been removed, or the link is mistyped.

notFound.title: This screen does not exist
notFound.body: The link may be mistyped, or it is for a newer version of Hold.

pay.agree: By paying, you agree to the hold and the prices above.
pay.cancelled: You closed PayPal before approving. Nothing was charged.

walkIn.approve: Pay {fee} and approve the {hold} hold with PayPal
walkIn.agree: You approve both in PayPal at once. Only the fee is charged. The hold is reserved, not charged. By approving, you agree to the hold and the prices above.
walkIn.placed: Your fee of {fee} is paid and your hold of {hold} is placed. Only the fee was charged.
walkIn.taking: Your hold of {hold} is placed. PayPal is taking your fee of {fee}.
walkIn.done: Hold placed. Only your fee is charged.

hold.title: Approve your hold
hold.lead: {amount} is reserved in your PayPal account while you rent. It is not a charge.
hold.notYet: The shop asks for the hold when you collect your items.
hold.agree: By approving, you agree to the hold and the shop's prices on your rental page.
hold.declined: PayPal declined the hold. Nothing was reserved. You can approve again with another way to pay.
hold.placed: Your hold of {amount} is placed. Nothing was charged.
hold.validUntil: It ends on {date} at the latest, and is released as soon as everything comes back as it left.
hold.replaceLead: Your hold ends on {date}, and your rental is still open. Approve a new hold of {amount} to keep it covered. It is not a charge, and the old hold is released as soon as you approve.

paid.title: Confirming your payment
paid.done: Payment confirmed. Your rental is booked.

pay.trustReason: Your hold is {amount}, not {ordinary}, because you have returned {count, plural, one {# rental} other {# rentals}} in good condition in the last {months} months.
pay.secure: PayPal opens in a secure window on this phone, and brings you straight back here.
pay.stillWorking: PayPal is still working on it. Check again in a moment.

condition.title: How your rental left
condition.lead: These are the photographs staff took at handover, with every mark they noted. You are never charged for anything shown here.

condition.openUntil: You can confirm it or add what was missed until {when}.
condition.closed: The time to answer has passed.
condition.repliedAdded: You added photographs of what was missed. The shop sees them with the handover.
condition.otherLink: Answer from the link the shop sent you at handover.
condition.add: Add a photograph of something missed
condition.notHandedOver: The rental has not been handed over yet.
condition.cameraHint: Photograph what staff missed, close up and in good light.

extend.latest: Your hold covers a return up to {when}, and the shop allows up to {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}.

closed.title: Extensions are for a rental you have with you

off.title: This shop does not take extensions from the phone

extend.noScope: This link shows the rental but cannot extend it. Use the link the shop sent with your booking.

refused.beyond_hold: Your hold covers a return up to {when}. To keep it longer than that, contact the shop.
refused.not_free: Someone has booked it from {when}. Choose an earlier time, or contact the shop.
refused.too_many_days: The shop allows up to {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}} from the phone. For longer, contact the shop.
refused.not_later: Choose a time after your current return time.
refused.not_out: Extensions are for a rental you have with you.
refused.off: This shop does not take extensions from the phone.
refused.no_hold: Your hold is not in place, so the shop needs to arrange this with you.
refused.quote_stale: The rental changed since this price was given. Choose the new time again.

quote.title: Your price
quote.days: {count, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}
quote.holdUnchanged: Paid now with PayPal, on its own. Your {hold} hold stays exactly as it is.
quote.agree: You approve this payment in PayPal. Your return time changes as soon as it is approved.

list.title: Your extensions
list.paid: {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}, to {when}. {amount} paid.
list.capturing: {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}, to {when}. {amount} being taken by PayPal.
list.failed: {days, plural, one {# more day} other {# more days}}, to {when}: PayPal refused the payment, so your return time did not change.

extended.title: Your extension
extended.done: Paid. Your new return time is set.
extended.reviewing: PayPal is reviewing your payment, which can take a day or more. Your new return time holds for now. If PayPal turns the payment down, or has not finished by your earlier return time, your earlier return time applies again.

code.sent: Code sent. It expires in ten minutes.
code.sentSandbox: Code sent to the booking’s contact address, since this is PayPal’s sandbox. It expires in ten minutes.
code.expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
code.wrong: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
code.recentlySent: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait a minute before asking again.
code.emailUnavailable: The code could not be sent. Try again in a moment.

code.emailInstead: Send it to my PayPal email instead
code.textUnavailable: The text could not be sent.
code.shownLabel: Sandbox: this text was not sent. It is what the renter would receive.

photo.takeHint: Opens the camera for this view.
photo.retakeHint: Opens the camera to take this view again.
photo.uploadFailed: The photograph did not upload. Try again.

incident.title: Something happened
incident.lead: Tell the shop what happened to what you rented. Your report is dated, locked and kept with the item’s history.
incident.emergencyFirst: If anyone is hurt or in danger, call the emergency number first: 112 in Europe, 911 in North America.
incident.closed: Reports are open while you have the items. Contact the shop about anything else.

hints.damage: A mark or damage, such as a scratch or a dent
hints.gone: It is gone: stolen or lost
hints.unsafe: Someone was hurt, or it might not be safe

start.describeHelp: In your own words. The shop reads exactly what you write.
start.describeMissing: Describe what happened, in up to 1,000 characters.

capture.title: Photographs
capture.guidance: Photograph what happened, from the side that shows it. The photograph taken when the item left is shown faintly behind the camera, so you can match the angle. Every view is optional.
capture.sampleBody: Some photographs here are samples for the demonstration, not of a real item.

send.noPhotos: No photographs yet. You can still send the report, for example if the item is gone.
send.howTo: Tap your photograph where the damage is. The box becomes the mark the return is checked against. It is optional.
send.tapToMark: Tap where the damage is on {view}
send.marked: Marked on {view}, around {x}% across and {y}% down
send.tapHint: Tap again to move the box.

outcome.simulated: Sorted by a stand-in for the test environment, not by Claude.

unsafe.title: Stop using the item
unsafe.stop: Please stop using it now, and keep it somewhere safe.
unsafe.contact: The shop has been told and will contact you.
unsafe.emergency: If anyone is hurt or in danger, call the emergency number: 112 in Europe, 911 in North America.

photographs.title: Not sent yet
photographs.body: Add photographs if you can, then send the report.

stored.title: Your report is stored
stored.body: The shop has been told and will contact you.

theft.title: A theft or loss
theft.body: The shop has been told and will contact you. Please give these details now. A police report number can be added later.

fault.title: A fault
fault.body: A fault is not charged to you. The shop has been told and will contact you about a swap or a collection.

pricing.title: Small damage
pricing.body: The shop will confirm which of its published prices applies, and this page will show it. Nothing is charged now.

offer.title: Small damage at a published price
offer.body: You can agree to it now, or leave it for the return. Nothing is charged now.

agreed.title: Agreed
agreed.body: You agreed the shop’s published price.
agreed.notCharged: Nothing has been charged. At the return a staff member confirms it after seeing the item, and can only lower it. It is charged once with any other line, and the rest of your hold is released.

return.title: Left for the return
return.body: A person at the shop will look at it when you bring the item back.

resolved.title: Settled
resolved.body: The shop has settled this report.

agree.codeGuidance: To agree this price, ask for a one-time code. It goes to the email PayPal gave for you.
agree.leaveGuidance: Or leave it for the return, when a person at the shop will look at it.

theft.lockAndKeys: The lock and the keys: was it locked, and where are the keys?
theft.policeLater: If you do not have one yet, you can add it later.

unavailable.title: This return is not open here
unavailable.body: {shop} takes this return at the counter. Bring it back while the shop is open.

when.open: A person at {shop} checks it today, while the shop is open.
when.later: A person at {shop} checks it when the shop opens, {when}.
when.unknown: A person at {shop} checks it when the shop next opens.

intro.title: Before you start
intro.holdStays: It stays reserved with PayPal until they do. Then it is released, or you get a claim with photographs that you can answer.
intro.how: Photograph each view the way it was photographed when you took it, then where you left it. About two minutes.
intro.light: Find good light. The photographs you take now are your proof of how you left it.
intro.noScope: This link shows the rental but cannot return it. Use the link the shop sent with your booking.

capture.title: Photograph the return
capture.guidance: The photograph from when you took it shows faintly behind the camera. Match its angle, then take the next view.
capture.dropPointGuidance: Step back so the item and the drop point are both in the photograph.
capture.sampleBody: These are samples for the demonstration, not photographs of your rental. The record says so.

send.ready: Every photograph is taken. Sending seals them, and your return counts from that moment.
send.missing: {count, plural, one {# photograph still to take} other {# photographs still to take}}

receipt.missingTitle: {shop} could not find it at the drop point
receipt.missingBody: They looked {when}. Please contact them. Your photographs from {time} stay on your rental’s record.
receipt.charged: Charged after a person approved a claim
receipt.fromRecord: From Hold’s record. PayPal could not be asked just now.
receipt.sample: A sample rental: no PayPal call is made.
receipt.photosBody: Sealed into your rental’s record at the moment you sent them. Nobody can change them.

steps.checkedDetail: A person saw it at the drop point.
steps.notFound: Not found at the drop point
steps.notFoundDetail: Please contact {shop}. Nothing is charged while they look into it.
steps.settle: Hold released, or a claim you can answer
steps.settleDetail: Nothing is charged without a person’s approval.
steps.charged: Charged after a person approved a claim

claim.title: Your damage claim

none.title: No claim
none.body: A person at the shop approves any claim first. If there is one after your return, it shows here with its photographs, and you can answer it.

claim.settledBody: PayPal confirmed settlement. This rental is closed.
claim.renterBoundary: Review the evidence and prices below. Accept with a verification code, or contest with your explanation.
claim.afterReply: Your answer is recorded. The evidence and prices stay below, and this page shows each step until it settles.
claim.repairedBody: The shop repaired what you paid for. What the repair cost stays with the shop.
claim.reviewFirst: Review the evidence and prices. Your reply period starts when you confirm you have reviewed this claim.
claim.codeGuidance: We send a one-time code to the email address PayPal confirmed when you paid.
claim.commentHint: Required to contest. Optional when you accept. Up to 1,000 characters.

contest.title: Where the two sides differ
contest.count: Disputed: {disputed} of {total, plural, one {# line} other {# lines}}
contest.neutral: Takes no side and names no amount. The facts under each line come from Hold's records. Check the evidence before deciding.

missing.pending: No summary has been written yet. The renter’s words and the records are below.
missing.refused: The summary could not be written this time. The renter's words and the records are below.
missing.unavailable: The summary could not be written this time. The renter's words and the records are below.
missing.invalid: The summary did not meet Hold's checks, so it is not shown. The renter's words and the records are below.
missing.dropped: The summary named a number, which Hold does not allow, so it is not shown. The renter's words and the records are below.

facts.confirmedTwice: Found by the comparison, and confirmed by an independent second look.
facts.foundOnce: Found by the comparison. The second look did not confirm it.
facts.markNearby: A mark recorded before this rental is near the same spot.
facts.noMarkNearby: No mark recorded before this rental is near this spot.
facts.agreedDuringRental: The renter agreed this price when they reported it during the rental.
facts.addedBy: Added by {name}, with a written reason.
facts.conditionConfirmed: The condition report at handover was confirmed, {when}, with nothing added.
facts.conditionAdded: Photographs of what staff missed were added to the condition report at handover.
facts.conditionNotAnswered: The condition report at handover was never answered.
facts.incidentReported: Something was reported during the rental.
facts.noIncident: Nothing was reported during the rental.
facts.renterPhotos: {count, plural, one {# photograph was} other {# photographs were}} added to the contest.

results.over_approval_limit: This claim exceeds your approval limit. Ask an owner or manager.
results.line_without_evidence: Each line needs photographs or your written reason.
results.raised_the_claim: Another owner or manager must decide a claim you raised.
results.role_may_not_confirm: Your role cannot confirm this action.
results.code_recently_sent: Wait one minute before requesting another code.
results.reply_expired: The reply period has ended. Ask the shop to review the claim.
results.already_replied: This claim already has a reply.
results.email_unavailable: The code could not be sent. Please try again later.
results.decision_recorded: A decision is already recorded. Refresh this page to see its settlement status.
results.incident_not_agreed: That report was not agreed by the renter.
results.raises_agreed_line: A line the renter agreed can be lowered, never raised.
results.empty_line: Leave the line out rather than keep it at nothing.
results.owner_decides_after_promise: The shop missed the date it promised the renter. Only the owner can decide this claim now.

promise.beforeBody: {shop} promises to decide within {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} of your reply. You will see the exact date as soon as you send it.
promise.keptBody: {shop} decided on {when}, by the date it promised.
promise.missedBody: {shop} promised to decide by {when}, and did not. The owner has been told. Only the owner can decide now, and they must give you a written reason.
promise.lateBody: {shop} promised to decide by {when} and decided later. The owner wrote:
promise.waivedBody: {shop} promised to decide by {when}. It did not, so under its own rule nothing is charged.

messages.renterHint: The shop is told by email that you wrote. Up to 1,000 characters.

messageResults.message_invalid: Write a message of up to 1,000 characters.
messageResults.rate_limited: Too many messages for now. Try again in an hour.
messageResults.not_found: This claim is not open for messages.

negotiation.title: Your advocate

none.title: No advocate yet
none.body: An advocate argues a contested claim only when you hand it one, from the claim, with the most you will pay.

negotiation.assistantArgues: Your own assistant argues your contest. Hold's advocate does not move for you, and every move passes Hold's referee.
negotiation.simulated: Simulated advocates: this is the test environment, and no AI model was asked.

advocate.title: Let an advocate argue it for me
advocate.guidance: An advocate reads the same photographs, marks and price list as the shop and argues each line on the evidence. It never sees the shop's limits, and the shop never sees yours. It uses the verification code we email you, as accepting or contesting does.
advocate.highest: The most I will pay, in {currency}
advocate.start: Hand my contest to an advocate
advocate.assistant: My own assistant, {name}. The name is its own and is not verified.
advocate.assistantGuidance: Your assistant reads the same evidence through Hold and makes each move through Hold's referee. It never sees the shop's limits and cannot agree to more than you write here. You still confirm any agreement with a code.
advocate.upTo: Your advocate may agree to pay up to

confirm.renterGuidance: Nothing is charged until you confirm. If you decline, the shop's owner decides.
confirm.lead: To confirm or decline, ask for a fresh one-time code by email.
confirm.waitingShop: You confirmed. Waiting for the shop to confirm.

stop.title: Stop my advocate
stop.guidance: Stopping charges nothing. The shop's owner then decides, and you can still see everything here.

states.agreed: The advocates agreed. Nothing is charged until each person confirms.
states.settled: Agreed and confirmed. The hold settles through PayPal.
states.escalated: The advocates did not settle it. The shop's owner decides, with this transcript.
states.replied: The renter's advocate wrote the contest below. The shop's owner decides.

ended.refused_twice: One advocate's moves were refused twice.
ended.deadline: The time for the negotiation ran out.
ended.mandate_ended: An advocate was stopped, or its limits ended.
ended.declined: A person declined the agreed amount.
ended.nothing_to_charge: They agreed on nothing to pay: the owner waives the claim.
ended.promise_missed: The shop's promised date passed: the owner decides.

transcript.title: What the advocates said
transcript.noLimits: The transcript shows each offer and the evidence it rests on. Neither side's limits are in it.
transcript.accept: Accepted the other side's last offer

passReasons.ceiling: The advocate reached its limit of time or calls.

transcript.chainVerified: The chain of fingerprints verifies: no move was changed, removed or reordered.
transcript.chainBroken: The chain of fingerprints does not verify.

grounds.known_mark: A mark that was already on the item lies next to it
grounds.uncertain_evidence: The photographs do not settle it
grounds.renter_photo: A photograph from the renter bears on it
grounds.goodwill: Goodwill, with no evidence behind it

results.amount_invalid: Write an amount, such as 30 or 30.50.
results.already_replied: This claim has already been answered.
results.invalid_limits: These limits cannot be used. Check each one.
results.not_agreed: There is no agreement waiting for an answer.
results.not_found: There is no advocate on this claim.
results.role_may_not_confirm: Only the owner or a manager can confirm this.
results.raised_the_claim: Someone other than the person who raised this claim must confirm it.
results.code_expired: This code has expired. Ask for a new one.
results.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
results.code_recently_sent: A code was sent less than a minute ago. Check your email.
results.email_unavailable: The email could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
results.link_invalid: This link cannot be used for this.
results.assistant_not_connected: No assistant is connected to this rental now. Choose Hold's advocate instead.

record.title: Your rental record
record.lead: Keep a versioned copy of the rental’s photographs, findings, decisions and settlement. Each prepared version stays unchanged.
record.requested: Your record is being prepared. This page updates automatically.
record.empty: No record has been prepared yet.
record.building: Preparing your record. This page updates automatically.
record.buildFailed: The record could not be prepared. Please try again.

receiptStates.failed: Delivery failed; it will be retried.

trust.title: Your Clean Record
trust.lead: Every rental you return in good condition is counted here. It carries no name, email or amount, and you decide whether other Hold shops use it.
trust.notYet: Your Clean Record starts once PayPal has confirmed your payment.
trust.counts: Your rentals in the last {months} months
trust.neverTakenNone: No hold has been released to you yet.
trust.credentialLead: Anyone can scan this code to check your record with Hold's published key. It shows only the counts above, and stops working at {time}. Open this page again for a new one.
trust.credentialScan: Scan to check this Clean Record
trust.credentialUnavailable: Your record cannot be signed right now. Try again in a moment.
trust.consentQuestion: Use my record of clean returns to lower future holds at Hold shops.
trust.consentIsOn: Other Hold shops may use your record to lower your hold.
trust.consentIsOff: Only each shop’s own record of your returns is used there.
trust.turnOn: Use my record at other Hold shops
trust.turnOff: Stop using my record at other Hold shops
trust.deleteLead: Your returns are removed at every Hold shop, and your next hold is the ordinary one. A claim still being settled stays until it is.
trust.deleteConfirm: I understand my record is deleted at every Hold shop

results.renter_unknown: Your record starts once PayPal has confirmed your payment.
results.code_expired: This code has expired or was already used. Ask for a new one.
results.wrong_code: That code is not right. Check the email and try again.
results.code_recently_sent: A code was sent a moment ago. Wait a minute before asking again.
results.email_unavailable: The email could not be sent. Try again in a moment.
results.payer_missing: Your record starts once PayPal has confirmed your payment.

trust.codeLead: Changing your record needs a code we email to the address PayPal has for you, so nobody else holding this link can change it.
trust.across: across {count, plural, one {# rental} other {# rentals}}

assistant.title: Your assistant

state.connected: An assistant is connected to this rental

assistant.notVerified: That name is its own and is not verified.
assistant.unnamed: an assistant that gave no name
assistant.lead: It can read this rental, its hold, its condition report and any claim, and draft a reply for you. It cannot pay, approve a hold or answer a claim: you do those yourself, in PayPal or on this link.
assistant.disconnectLead: Its token stops working at its next call. This link keeps working as before.
assistant.disconnected: Disconnected. Its next call will be refused.
assistant.notConnected: No assistant is connected to this rental now.

draft.title: A reply it drafted for you
draft.note: These are the assistant's words and decide nothing. To answer, open the claim from your link and confirm with the code Hold emails you.

tools.get_booking: Checked whether the fee was paid
tools.get_hold_approval_link: Asked for the link to approve the hold
tools.request_extension: Asked the price of more days, and the link to pay for them
tools.draft_claim_reply: Drafted a reply to the claim
tools.get_claim_lines: Read the claim's lines and findings
tools.get_known_marks: Read the marks known before the rental
tools.submit_offer: Made a move as your advocate

contact.title: How we reach you
contact.emailBody: Links, reminders and codes come by email. No email on this phone? Choose texts instead.
contact.textBody: Links, reminders and codes come by text. A copy of any money decision also goes to the email PayPal has for you.
contact.notConfirmedBody: Links and reminders come by text. Codes come by email until you confirm this number.
contact.phoneLabel: Your mobile number, with its country code
contact.newPhoneLabel: Your new mobile number, with its country code
contact.privacy: Hold uses this number only for this rental's links, reminders and codes.
contact.confirmedNow: Texts about this rental now go to {phone}.
contact.changeLead: To move your texts to a new phone, we first send a code where your codes go now.
contact.changeCodeEmailed: Code sent to the email PayPal has for you. It expires in ten minutes.

results.phone_invalid: Write the number with its country code, such as +41 79 123 45 67.
results.country_not_texted: Hold does not send texts to that country. Your codes come by email.
results.code_needed: The hold is placed, so a new number first needs the code sent where your codes go now.
results.code_recently_sent: Wait one minute before asking for another code.
results.code_expired: That code has expired. Ask for a new one.
results.text_unavailable: The text could not be sent.
results.email_unavailable: The code could not be sent. Please try again later.
results.payer_missing: Pay the fee first: PayPal then tells Hold where to send your codes.

contact.unavailable: How we reach you cannot be changed from this link.

push.offerTitle: Hear about this rental on this phone
push.offerBody: Hold can tell you here when your condition report, a claim, a message from the shop or your receipt is ready. One-time codes still come only by text or email.
push.counterOfferTitle: Hear about the counter on this phone
push.counterOfferBody: Hold can tell you here when a drop-off waits, a renter writes, a return comparison is ready, or a decision waits on the web.
push.onBody: This phone hears about this rental.
push.offBody: This phone does not hear about this rental. Texts and emails still come.
push.counterOffBody: This phone does not hear about {shop}. Emails still come.
push.deniedBody: Allow them for Hold in the phone's Settings, then turn them on here.
push.unavailableTitle: Notifications could not be turned on
push.unavailableBody: This phone could not get an address for notifications. Please try again later.
push.failedBody: Nothing was turned on. Please try again.
